name: a hand actually on the bullets
did: Reload grips fixed. The support hand was 46 to 58 mm away from the shells, stripper clips and revolver rounds it was supposed to be carrying, for the whole of every reload -- only the magazines were right. Where the fingers close is measured off the load's own geometry now instead of being a typed number, so every one of them is held.
onAccept: The armoury reloads. Your loadouts are kept; anything you had equipped that moved class is still where you left it.
